name: Montrose
card: A regional city in the Uncompahgre Valley, south of the Grand Valley.
near: It connects the Grand Valley to the San Juan range along US-50 and US-550.
metaTitle: Montrose Websites and Local SEO | Nick Perry Digital
metaDescription: Websites and local SEO for Montrose, Colorado. One listing if you have one location. Posted prices and a local FAQ.
body:
Montrose is a regional center for a wide rural area. People drive in for services, and businesses there often cover towns that do not have their own specialist.

That reach is not an excuse for a second Google listing in Grand Junction. If you have one shop, you get one profile, plus a site that tells the truth about how far you travel.
businesses: Contractors serving Montrose and the surrounding valleys
Retail that draws from a wide radius
extraQ: I serve both Montrose and Grand Junction. Do I need two listings?
extraA: Only if you have two real locations. One shop means one Google Business Profile and a service area that matches the drive. Two listings for one front door is a common way to get suspended.
